GENERAL INFORMATION 
 
Approximate living costs and health insurance: 
992 € per month (accommodation included) - see further information at 
https://www.study-in-germany.de/en/ 
 
Accommodation: 
 
THA does not have own halls of residence. 
There is only a limited capacity of rooms available from the housing corporation “Studierendenwerk 
Augsburg” and from other private housing corporations for incoming exchange students of THA. 
Currently it happens that the number of available rooms or apartments will not be large enough to serve 
all applicants with an accommodation. Oversea students will be served first. 
 
Once an accommodation is reserved by the International Office, no changes will be possible. All 
rent contracts are binding for a time period of 6 months and are only valid for one semester . This is 
the only way we can provide housing for the next incoming exchange students. If you extend your  stay 
or apply for two semesters, you will have to look for a new accommodation for the extended semest er. 
The average rent is ~300 € - 450 € per month (general electricity and heating mostly included). 
 
Other expenses: 
 
It is compulsory for all students (exchange and domestic) to pay 177,25 € student services fee upon 
arrival. This amount covers the cost of your student ID card (Campus Card) 85,00 € as well as the 
Augsburg Public Transportation System (“AVV and avg”) 92,25 € for one semester. Further information: 
https://www.tha.de/en/IT-Services-Center/Campus-Card.html 
 
Student services / facilities available: 
• Orientation Week for international exchange students 
• The Student Welcome Team (https://www.instagram.com/swop_team/) helps with the organization 
of meetings, parties and trips 
• German language courses accompanying the regular courses; potentially preparative German 
language intensive courses available for purchase https://www.tha.de/en/International/German-as-a-
Foreign-Language 
• Possibility of passing official exams in German as a foreign language (DSH, TestDaF). 
• Free access to the library, computer rooms, laboratories 
• Augsburg University of Applied Sciences has the infrastructure to welcome students with disabilities 
 
Transcript of Records (ToR): 
Exchange incoming students will be able to download and print a digitally created document via their 
personal student account with the current date on it up to the last day of the registered semester at the 
latest. 
The document is officially valid without a signature. We don't stamp and sign it in addition 
and we won't send it by mail, except of "special transcripts" from the faculty beside the official ToR. This 
shall protect the environment and save us postage. 
If there is something missing in the ToR after the semester ended, just let us know and we will take care 
of it as soon as possible. 
If there are any doubts in the correctness of the content of the ToR, please contact the International 
Office of THA for a confirmation: International Office international@tha.de
